name: thread
message: the thread was not reread in this conversation for: {missing}. Run thread-check <address> first, read its verdict, then write from where the thread stands.
why: Replies sent without rereading the thread re-introduced the sender to people who had already answered, and repeated questions already settled.

name: kill-by-pattern
message: no process is killed by pattern: find the PID, check what it is, then kill that PID.
why: pkill on a broad pattern killed the operator's own sessions and a long render.

name: check-after-deploy
message: a deployment shipped in this turn and nothing checked that the new code answers. Fetch the live URL and read what it returns.
why: Deployments reported as done while the old code was still served.

name: search-before-absence
message: the answer concludes that something does not exist without having run the unified search on it.
why: "I don't have that information" was said about facts sitting in an email or an earlier task.

trigger.final_text: \b(not found|does not exist|doesn't exist|no trace|I don't have)\b
